name: Hero-like Octree Traversal
definition: A depth-first search approach for ray-tracing octrees that uses a 2x2x2 voxel test to determine the order of cell hits and descend into occupied nodes.
summary: Hero-like Octree Traversal is a depth-first ray-tracing algorithm that explicitly computes child traversal order using bitmask logic and a stack to skip hidden objects.
